title: Inventory KANBUS_* environment variables and close the Python/Rust gaps
description: Item 6 of kbs-eb1788. Rust reads 70 KANBUS_* names, Python 47. Rust-only: console and cloud auth settings (KANBUS_AUTH_MODE, KANBUS_API_STAGE, KANBUS_CLOUD_*, KANBUS_COGNITO_*, KANBUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, KANBUS_IOT_DATA_ENDPOINT, KANBUS_MQTT_CUSTOM_AUTHORIZER_NAME, KANBUS_TENANT_*_CLAIM_KEY), KANBUS_SNYK_DEBUG, the prefixes KANBUS_REALTIME_ and KANBUS_COORDINATION_, and KANBUS_TEST_* hooks. Python-only: KANBUS_NON_INTERACTIVE, KANBUS_ROUTER_MQTT_DIAGNOSTICS, KANBUS_ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS. Work: document every variable in one table (name, purpose, runtimes, intentional or gap); port user-facing gaps spec-first; list console/server-only and test-hook variables as intentional Rust-only or Python-only; identify variables that only served the retired legacy cloud console (kbs-14a848) for a separate removal task.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: PR #536 merged with CI green. docs/ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md lists all 71 KANBUS_* variables (27 shared, 18 shared test hooks, 10 single-runtime, 14 legacy-cloud, 2 documented gaps: KANBUS_SNYK_DEBUG debug output and KANBUS_ROUTER_MQTT_DIAGNOSTICS harness diagnostics). Rust now honours KANBUS_NON_INTERACTIVE and the no-TTY refusal with KANBUS_FORCE_INTERACTIVE, matching Python. Legacy-cloud removal filed as kbs-109538.
